LESSON: NIMPENDAYE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.23: Nimpendaye

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Nimpendaye. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutaja majina ya ndege mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
2. kutambua msamiati unaotumiwa katika kutunza ndege ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
3. kutumia majina ya ndege katika sentensi sahihi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo
4. kutumia msamiati wa kutunza 109 ndege katika sentensi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo e) kusoma maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga usomaji bora f) kuandika maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga uandishi bora g) kuthamini utunzaji wa ndege ampendaye. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutaja majina ya ndege mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutaja majina ya ndege mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kutambua msamiati unaotumiwa katika kutunza ndege ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati unaotumiwa katika kutunza ndege ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kutumia majina ya ndege katika sentensi sahihi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia majina ya ndege katika sentensi sahihi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutumia msamiati wa kutunza 109 ndege katika sentensi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo e) kusoma maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga usomaji bora f) kuandika maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga uandishi bora g) kuthamini utunzaji wa ndege ampendaye. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia msamiati wa kutunza 109 ndege katika sentensi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo e) kusoma maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga usomaji bora f) kuandika maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga uandishi bora g) kuthamini utunzaji wa ndege ampendaye. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Nimpendaye.
2. Explain Nimpendaye to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Nimpendaye.
4. Show that you can: kutaja majina ya ndege mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Nimpendaye. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Nimpendaye important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutaja majina ya ndege mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kuzungumza
2. kutambua msamiati unaotumiwa katika kutunza ndege ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
3. kutumia majina ya ndege katika sentensi sahihi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo
4. kutumia msamiati wa kutunza 109 ndege katika sentensi ili kuwezesha mazungumzo e) kusoma maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga usomaji bora f) kuandika maneno na sentensi kuhusu ndege ampendaye ili kujenga uandishi bora g) kuthamini utunzaji wa ndege ampendaye. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
